# Browser Parquet reader

Hyparquet **1.33.1**, vendored from the upstream npm package without modification.

- Source: https://github.com/hyparam/hyparquet
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/hyparquet/v/1.33.1
- Entry point: `hyparquet/src/index.js`
- License: MIT; see `hyparquet/LICENSE`.

The application uses the built-in Snappy decoder. It makes no runtime CDN or
third-party API requests. All site assets and data are served by GitHub Pages.
